info.title: How it works
info.original: No re-encoding or additional quality loss. The format depends on VK, for example MP3 or M4A. No new tags, artwork or lyrics are added.
info.mp3: Audio is re-encoded as MP3 at the selected bitrate, even if the source is already MP3. This takes longer. Tags, artwork and lyrics are added according to your settings. Lyrics from public sources may be inaccurate.
